chunks: But We saved him and those with him in the ark, and made it a sign for the creatures of the world.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the ark as a sign for the world in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine preservation of the Prophet (often identified as Noah or Hud depending on the specific contextual linkage in Tafsir al-Mizan) and his faithful companions, emphasizing that the Ark serves as a universal sign (ayah) of God's power and mercy. The term 'for the worlds' (lil-'alamin) underscores the cosmic scope of this miracle, inviting all creation to reflect on the transition from destruction to salvation. This narrative reinforces the Shia concept of divine intervention in history as a continuous source of guidance and proof for humanity.
